enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up to shoulders. Adjusts pillow under head. Lies still. Turns to right side. Bends knees. Places arm under pillow. Turns to back. Places hand on chest. Snores. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket down. Lies still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow again. Lies still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Yawns. Stretches arms. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Splashes water on face. Rubs eyes. Turns off tap. Picks up towel. Wipes face. Hangs towel. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits in sink. Turns on tap. Rinses toothbrush. Turns off tap. Puts toothbrush back. Wipes mouth. Turns off light.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and eggs. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Takes out bowl and fork. Cracks eggs into bowl. Whispers eggs. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Pours egg mixture into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off stove. Places eggs on plate. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Eats eggs. Drinks milk. Wipes mouth with napkin.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work uniform and packing bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Turns on light. Opens closet. Takes out work uniform. Closes closet. Takes off pajamas. Puts on uniform shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens drawer. Takes out badge. Closes drawer. Attaches badge to shirt. Opens bag. Places stethoscope in bag. Places notebook in bag. Places pen in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Turns off light. Exits bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health clinic for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens driver's door. Sits in seat. Closes door. Fastens seatbelt. Adjusts rearview mirror. Inserts key. Starts engine. Checks mirrors. Releases parking brake. Drives out of driveway. Stops at traffic light. Turns left. Drives on main road. Stops at red light. Continues driving. Parks car in clinic parking lot. Turns off engine. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Closes door. Locks car. Walks to clinic entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and updating clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enters clinic. Greets receptionist. Walks to office. Turns on computer. Logs in. Reviews patient schedule. Calls first patient. Takes vital signs. Measures blood pressure. Listens to heart. Asks patient questions. Types notes into computer. Sends prescription to pharmacy. Calls next patient. Takes vital signs. Measures blood pressure. Listens to heart. Asks patient questions. Types notes into computer. Sends prescription to pharmacy.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to break room. Opens locker. Takes out lunch bag. Closes locker. Sits at table. Opens lunch bag. Takes out sandwich. Takes out apple. Takes out water bottle. Unwraps sandwich. Takes bite. Chews. Swallows. Drinks water. Takes another bite. Eats apple. Wipes mouth with napkin. Throws away trash. Puts lunch bag back in locker.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing patient care duties and coordinating with the clinical team
enriched_activities.desc: Returns to office. Checks messages. Calls patient. Discusses case with colleague. Attends team meeting. Updates patient charts. Orders lab tests. Reviews test results. Calls patient with results. Sees next patient. Takes vital signs. Measures blood pressure. Listens to heart. Asks patient questions. Types notes into computer. Sends prescription to pharmacy. Coordinates with nurse. Reviews schedule for next day.

Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens door. Sits in seat. Closes door. Fastens seatbelt. Adjusts mirror. Starts engine. Drives out of parking lot. Stops at traffic light. Drives on highway. Stops at toll booth. Pays toll. Continues driving. Exits highway. Drives on local roads. Parks car in driveway. Turns off engine. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Closes door. Locks car. Walks to front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to recover from the heatwave day
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature to cool. Takes off clothes. Places clothes in hamper. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rinses body. Washes hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Wipes mirror. Turns off light.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and chicken. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out pan and knife. Closes cabinet. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds chicken. Cooks chicken. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Wipes mouth with napkin.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and reading quietly while keeping lights and appliances off during peak energy hours
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Does not turn on light. Sits on sofa. Picks up book from coffee table. Opens book to bookmark. Reads page. Turns page. Reads next page. Turns page. Adjusts sitting position. Crosses legs. Reads more pages. Closes book. Places book on coffee table. Leans back on sofa. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Opens eyes. Gets up. Walks to kitchen. Returns with glass of water. Sits back on sofa. Drinks water. Places glass on table. Picks up book again. Opens book. Reads.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and running the dishwasher during off-peak hours
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Scrapes food scraps from plates into trash. Opens dishwasher. Loads plates into dishwasher. Loads glasses. Loads utensils. Adds dishwasher detergent. Closes dishwasher door. Presses start button. Wipes counter with sponge. Rinses sponge. Wipes stove. Turns off light. Exits kitchen.

Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Washes hands with soap. Rinses hands. Dries hands with towel. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits in sink. Rinses toothbrush. Puts toothbrush back. Washes face with cleanser. Rinses face. Dries face with towel. Applies moisturizer. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind down, setting an alarm and charging the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Turns on light. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Picks up phone. Opens clock app. Sets alarm for 6:30 AM. Closes clock app. Picks up charger. Plugs charger into wall outlet. Connects phone to charger. Places phone on nightstand. Turns off light. Pulls back blanket. Lies down in bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply.

Lies on back. Eyes closed. Breathes regularly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Lies still. Turns to right side. Places arm under pillow. Bends knees. Turns to back. Places hand on chest. Snores. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket down. Lies still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Lies still.
